welcome:
👋 Welcome to *KIA DropAgentX*!

🛍 Marketplace · 👛 Wallet · 🎯 Quests · 🤝 Referrals · 🤖 AI assistant

Tap a button below or just type anything to talk to my AI brain.
error_generic: ⚠️ Something went wrong. Please try again.
panic_mode: 🚨 Maintenance mode is ON. Only the owner can use the bot right now.
not_whitelisted: ⛔ You are not whitelisted yet. Ask the owner for access.
rate_limited: ⏳ Slow down! Please wait {seconds}s and try again.
help_body:
/market — browse the marketplace
/wallet — balance, top-up, transfers
/orders — my purchases & deliveries
/quests — daily quests & rewards
/leaderboard — top users
/referral — invite & earn
/book — book a meeting
/lang — change language
/support — talk to support agent

Or just chat with me — I'm powered by 6 AI agents!
market_empty: 📦 No products yet — be the first seller! (Owner can add via /owner)
market_search_hint: 🔎 Send a keyword to search, or /market for all products.
purchase_pending_stars: 🧾 Invoice sent — pay with ⭐ Stars to complete your order.
insufficient_funds:
💸 Not enough credits. Balance: {balance}, needed: {needed}.
Top up via 👛 Wallet.
no_orders: No orders yet — time to grab something from /market!
review_prompt: ⭐ How would you rate this product? Send 1-5.
topup_stars_hint: Send the number of ⭐ Stars to convert (e.g. 100). Rate: 1 ⭐ = {rate} credits.
withdraw_requested: 📝 Withdrawal request submitted — waiting for owner approval (HITL).
ai_placeholder: Just type anything — my AI agents are listening!
ai_disabled: 🤖 AI key not configured — running in smart-rules mode. Ask the owner to set AI_API_KEY.
booking_none: No upcoming bookings. /book to schedule one.
broadcast_hint: 📣 Send the message to broadcast. It will be queued for YOUR approval first (HITL).
kill_switch_on: 🚨 PANIC MODE ON — bot locked for everyone except staff.
welcome_bonus: 🎁 Welcome! +{credits} credits added to your wallet.
